about: B1f (18 Nov 2026): the model never promises a delivery time that no tool returned this turn, and never names a time outside the hours. B1e's sim-test (run 44237193445, sim-015) heard «ma 3andi wa2t tawseel bokra» from the model with no tool behind it; B1e's area guard covers places only. The output guard (packages/agents/src/output-guard.ts, time_claim) refuses a sentence that says when an order arrives or is delivered (a number of minutes or hours, a clock time, today, tonight, tomorrow) unless quote_order or the delivery windows returned times this turn (`quoted`), and refuses a clock time outside the hours (settings.hours, read from the database and passed in; 09:00 to 21:00 today) whatever the tools said. The gateway checks it again. Code's own messages (the card's ⏱️ line, the windows list) are not model text and are not checked here. Run by packages/agents/test/time-claim-b1f.test.ts.
